title: English Practice Quiz 0931
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A shift roster shows ___.
options: who is assigned to work and when
questions.explanation: A roster lists work assignments and timings.

questions.question: If you need to swap shifts, you should ___.
options: request approval through the proper process
questions.explanation: Shift changes should be approved and recorded.

questions.question: An overlapping shift occurs when ___.
options: two shifts share part of the same time period
questions.explanation: Overlap means two scheduled periods coincide for some time.

questions.question: A day off in a roster means ___.
options: the employee is not scheduled to work that day
the employee must work twice as long
the office is closed to everyone
the employee is on a night shift
questions.explanation: A day off is a scheduled non-working day.

questions.question: If you are delayed and may miss the start of your shift, you should ___.
options: inform the supervisor as soon as possible
ask a colleague to falsify attendance
questions.explanation: Early notice helps supervisors arrange coverage.

questions.question: A rotating shift pattern means employees ___.
options: move between different shift times according to a schedule
work only at one fixed time forever
questions.explanation: Rotating shifts change according to an established pattern.

questions.question: A handover period allows outgoing and incoming staff to ___.
An absentee is an employee who ___.
questions.explanation: Absentee refers to a person who is away from work.

questions.question: A roster should be updated when an approved shift change ___.
options: is only discussed as a rumour
questions.explanation: The roster should reflect confirmed and approved changes.

questions.question: A weekly schedule helps employees plan ___.
questions.explanation: A schedule makes work expectations and timings clear.
